deep_dive.executive_summary: Elemental Royalty is a listed gold and silver royalty company with no borrowings at the last year end and a large cash balance. The 2025 operating cash is real, and it is also an incomplete year of the merged company. Using that cash, ending shares, no growth, and a 15 times sale in year 7, the plain owner-cash path is about -6.1% per year. The valuation file's base case, after the engine's scenario blend and a small qualitative adjustment, is -4.55% per year. That is below a hurdle that would make this a buy on the reported cash alone. Stance is watch until a full year of the combined comp...
